## Skills covered

-   Driving AI adoption strategies using the **Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF)** for Azure — requirements analysis, ROI evaluation, and agentic-first solution roadmaps
-   Applying the **Microsoft Power Platform Well-Architected Framework (WAF)** to intelligent application workloads
-   Designing multi-agent solutions with **Azure AI Foundry**, **Copilot Studio**, and **Microsoft 365 Copilot** — task, autonomous, and prompt/response agents
-   Working with open interoperability standards: **Model Context Protocol (MCP)** and **Agent-to-Agent (A2A)** protocol
-   Designing ALM processes for agents, custom models, and AI components across the full Microsoft AI platform
-   Governing, securing, and monitoring agentic workloads — responsible AI, prompt manipulation mitigations, data residency, and audit trails
